name: Death Baron
oracle_text: Skeletons you control and other Zombies you control get +1/+1 and have deathtouch. (Any amount of damage they deal to a creature is enough to destroy it.)
blocked_sentences: Skeletons you control and other Zombies you control get +1/+1 and have deathtouch.

needs.what: a static ability `affects` filter that is a union of sub-filters, each with its own `exclude_self` ("Skeletons you control" including the source OR "other Zombies you control" excluding it), so a creature matching both branches (a Skeleton Zombie, or any changeling) is affected once and gets +1/+1, not +2/+2
needs.why_existing_wont_do: static_filter_keys has no `any_of`/`union` and no `not_subtypes`. One static with subtypes [Skeleton, Zombie] cannot apply `exclude_self` to only the Zombie branch; two separate buff/grant_keyword statics (Skeleton; Zombie + exclude_self) double-apply the +1/+1 to every creature that is both a Skeleton and a Zombie, which changelings make common in a Zombie deck. `any_of`/`union` exist in selector_keys and cost_reduction_filter_keys but not for statics
